review.tagline: Workflow layer for Codex CLI with skills, roles and durable project state
review.summary: OMX wraps OpenAI Codex CLI with an `omx` launcher, skills such as `$deep-interview`, `$ralplan`, `$ultragoal`, `$team` and `$code-review`, and specialist roles. Plans, logs, memory and mode state are kept under `.omx/`, and team workers run in separate git worktrees, with tmux for the team runtime. Codex remains the execution engine; OMX adds scoped AGENTS.md guidance and an optional Codex plugin layout.
review.audience: Codex CLI users wanting structured planning and parallel agent workflows
strengths: Staged workflow: interview, plan, then durable execution with checkpoints in .omx/ultragoal
Team workers get dedicated git worktrees automatically; named worktrees isolate sessions
Installs with npm; omx doctor and omx exec smoke test check install and auth
Also ships a Codex plugin layout with marketplace metadata
weaknesses: Tuned mainly for macOS/Linux; native Windows and Codex App get less support
Requires Codex CLI installed and authenticated; does not run standalone
--madmax disables Codex approvals and sandbox, so only use in trusted repos
Large skill and command surface; loading many skills bloats context
needs: Needs Node.js 20+, OpenAI Codex CLI, tmux (macOS/Linux team runtime), git
